description: AICTIONBOT™ invoice comparison by KULIC Advisory (tool 62). Takes the items of the previous invoice and of the new invoice from the same supplier and matches them by description, otherwise by item number. Returns every item that is more expensive than last time (red: was this announced?), new items (yellow), quantity changes with jumps over 20 percent flagged, cheaper and no longer billed items, the split of the difference into price, quantity, new and dropped, ready questions for the supplier and the next step. Pass two arrays (old_rows for the previous invoice, new_rows for the new one) or one array rows with a version column (Old or New; German: Alt or Neu). Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. To check an invoice against order and goods receipt use match_documents or check_invoice. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

new_rows.description: New invoice with the same columns.

old_rows.description: Previous invoice: position (item number), description, quantity, unit_price, optionally total. German column names work too.

rows.description: Alternative to old_rows and new_rows: one list with a version column (Old or New) plus the columns above.

name: compare_invoices
title: Invoice against previous invoice: silent price increases, new items and quantity jumps from the same supplier, with questions
